description: Builds and reviews Advanced Custom Fields field groups defined in PHP or Local JSON. Covers stable group and field keys, storage names, acf/init timing, location rules, REST exposure, plugin-owned JSON paths, deployment, and Free versus PRO field availability. Use when adding a new ACF-backed meta field, converting an admin-created group to code, shipping field definitions in a plugin or theme, fixing duplicate keys or missing frontend fields, or deciding whether a field belongs in ACF at all.
